description: context-checker hooks — (1) UserPromptSubmit: inject a one-shot warning when context usage crosses the notice (60%) or critical (75%) threshold, so the session wraps up its sub-task before auto-compact fires. (2) PreCompact: write a markdown checkpoint of recent user messages, assistant replies, files touched, and bash commands before the transcript is summarized away. (3) PostCompact: point Claude at that checkpoint and reset the threshold state so later crossings warn again.
